jp:
「できあがった　お面に　よるけど
　にてる人が　どこかに　いるかもね」
　{KP}
「そんな人を　さがし出すと
　いいことが　あるらしいよ！」
en: "It depends on the mask you get made, but there might be someone out there who looks like it."{KP}"They say good things happen if you find someone like that!"

jp:
「この村に　ある　お面屋なんてね
　あんまり　おめに　かかれないわよ！」
　{KP}
「お面を　買ったら　ステータスで
　{bb}お面の絵{ww}を　選べば」
　{KP}
「どんな　お面を　持っているか
　わかるのよ　桃太郎さん！」
en: "A mask shop like the one in this village? You won't come face to face with one of those very often!"{KP}"Once you buy a mask, choose {bb}Mask Pictures{ww} under Status,"{KP}"and you can see which masks you have, Momotaro-san!"
"Hey, hey! Psst, psst, Momotaro-san!"{KP}"Won't you stay and hear our village chief's story? It's a little long, though..."{KN}

"Ooh, you want to hear it that badly? ......Well then,"{KP}"they say that while he was on a journey, praying to Kannon-sama in the Capital of Hope,"{KP}"he got a message telling him to treasure the first thing he picked up!"{KP}"Then on his way home, he was playing with a horsefly he'd tied up with a straw he'd picked up,"{KP}"and the mother of a child who wanted it asked to trade him an orange for it..."{KP}"And after that, the orange became a bolt of cloth, the cloth a horse, and the horse a mansion!"{KP}"Then he sold the mansion, made a fortune, and bought this village!"{KP}"Don't you just envy him?"

jp:
「あら　やだ～！
　聞いておかないと　ダメよ～！」
en: "Oh, come on! You really ought to hear it!"

jp:
「{bb}にらめっこアップップ！{ww}で
　ぜったいに　負けない
　お面は　ないそうです！」{KP}
　
「１つ　お面を　つくったら
　何回も　勝負すると　いいですよ！」
en: "They say there's no mask that never loses at {bb}Funny Face Face-Off!{ww}"{KP}"Once you've made a mask, it's a good idea to play lots of rounds!"

jp:
「この村の　宝物堂の中に
　いらっしゃる　{bb}観音さま{ww}と
　同じ　お顔をした　{bb}観音さま{ww}が」{KP}
　
「{bb}希望の都{ww}の　お寺の中に
　いらっしゃるようじゃ！」
en: "It seems a {bb}Kannon-sama{ww} with the same face as the {bb}Kannon-sama{ww} in this village's treasure hall"{KP}"is enshrined in the temple in the {bb}Capital of Hope{ww}!"

jp:
「ここから　南に　くだれば
　{bb}浦島の村{ww}が　あり」
　{KP}
「北東に　ずーと　進めば
　{bb}寝太郎の村{ww}が　ありますよ！」
en: "If you head south from here, there's {bb}Urashima Village{ww},"{KP}"and if you go a long way northeast, there's {bb}Netaro Village{ww}!"

jp:
「よく来たな　桃太郎！
　この村は　わらしべの村じゃ」
